Title: (LSJ) Some more Mask of thousand faces questions

Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:
Hello,

- Mata Hari attempts a bleed and uses False Resonance superior (+1
stealth and once this action, this vampire can burn one blood to
cancel a reaction card that requires auspex).

Durga Syn masks the action.

The "this vampire can burn one blood..." part carries over to Durga
Syn, is that right ?
If Mata had burned one blood to cancel an auspex reaction before Durga
Syn considered masking the action, could Durga mask the action ?

- Mata Hari (7 cap) attempts a bleed. Nadima (8 cap) attempts to
block. Mata plays Into thin air (+2 stealth, and once this action, she
can burn 1 blood to give an ally or younger vampire -1 intercept).

Durga Syn (9 cap) masks the action.

Can Durga Syn burn 1 blood to give Nadima -1 intercept (while Mata
Hari couldn't) ?

- Durga Syn bleeds. Nadima attempts to block. Durga plays Into Thin
Air.

Can Mata mask the action if Durga did not burn a blood to give Nadima
-1 intercept ?
Can Mata mask if Durga burned 1 blood to give Nadima -1 intercept ?

Thank you,

François

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
François wrote:
> Hello,
>
>
> - Mata Hari attempts a bleed and uses False Resonance superior (+1
> stealth and once this action, this vampire can burn one blood to
> cancel a reaction card that requires auspex).
>
> Durga Syn masks the action.
>
> The "this vampire can burn one blood..." part carries over to Durga
> Syn, is that right ?

Yes. [RTR 19-MAY-2003]

> If Mata had burned one blood to cancel an auspex reaction before Durga
> Syn considered masking the action, could Durga mask the action ?

Yes.

> - Mata Hari (7 cap) attempts a bleed. Nadima (8 cap) attempts to
> block. Mata plays Into thin air (+2 stealth, and once this action, she
> can burn 1 blood to give an ally or younger vampire -1 intercept).
>
> Durga Syn (9 cap) masks the action.
>
> Can Durga Syn burn 1 blood to give Nadima -1 intercept (while Mata
> Hari couldn't) ?

Yes.

> - Durga Syn bleeds. Nadima attempts to block. Durga plays Into Thin
> Air.
>
> Can Mata mask the action if Durga did not burn a blood to give Nadima
> -1 intercept ?

Yes.

> Can Mata mask if Durga burned 1 blood to give Nadima -1 intercept ?

No. Mata is not older than Nadima, so she could not have given Nadima -1 intercept.
